dogecoin.text: @jacksonjhin I tend to agree, but if Dogecoin is at a $2bn market cap could easily be wrong.

If I had to guess, I'd say average #cryptocurrency sentiment is around point 8 or so on the chart. 

On one hand, the major currencies have proven extremely resilient before.

On the other hand, Dogecoin is still worth $400m. https://t.co/OkVnKHsvRC

As long as #dogecoin has meaningful market cap (~$700m as I write), there's air left in the cryptobubble. This isn't to malign the many investment-grade tokens, but suggests that even after the recent correction we're not yet in a sane environment.

3/ This is likely to play out at some point in the next few years, if not sooner. Over whatever time horizon it takes, it is very hard to see how @Bitcoin will perform well- some of the same animal spirits driving @dogecoin are also baked into $BTC and will dissipate

2/ Even the smartest crypto investors believe that many of the top 100 coins today are zeros or at best near-zeros long term. @dogecoin is a perfect example. Still sitting at $400m of value (down from $2bn).
